# ChipGroup

**Class:** `UltraCanvasChipGroup` · **Group:** [Buttons and choices](../Groups/Buttons-and-choices.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasChipGroup.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasChipGroup.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasChipGroup.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Pick one (or several) of a row of chips - categories, filters, tags ([doc](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasChipGroup.md))

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasChipGroup](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasChipGroup.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasChipGroup> CreateChipGroup(const std::string& identifier, float x = -1, float y = -1, float w = -1, float h = -1);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasChipGroup(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasChipGroup(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasChipGroup(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onSelectionChanged` | `std::function<void(int index)> onSelectionChanged` | single mode (-1: none) |
| `onSelectedIndicesChanged` | `std::function<void(const std::vector<int>&)> onSelectedIndicesChanged` | any mode |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md): `SetScrollChangedCallback`, `SetChildAddedCallback`, `SetChildRemovedCallback`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
